          WSL Match Predictions
        
      
                          
                      Sep 24, 2026
          
                      Chloe Horswill / Author, Jordan Collins / Design
                  
      
              
                      
                  
          

    
              
      
              
                    
With the help of the Opta supercomputer, we provide our WSL match predictions for Matchday 4 of the 2026-27 season.

With three matchdays down in the Women's Super League season, defending champions Manchester City remain the only team with a 100% record, following their frantic 4-2 victory over Liverpool last time out.

After drawing 2-2 with Bayern Munich in their Champions League opener on Tuesday, City visit Charlton Athletic – who are the only team yet to pick up a point – to kickstart the week’s action on Saturday, before focus turns to their potential title rivals.
Neither Chelsea nor Arsenal have suffered a defeat yet this campaign, but with both already off City's pace, their head-to-head clash at Stamford Bridge on Sunday looks vital.
There is also a Merseyside derby between Liverpool and Everton, while Manchester United will look to finally earn their first league victory under Eva Olid at home to West Ham.
Who will come out on top in the WSL this weekend? We have a look at the Opta supercomputer’s  Matchday 4 predictions.

With Man City boasting a perfect record and Charlton recording three straight defeats since their promotion, it should come as little surprise that our predictive model makes Andree Jeglertz's champions the clearest MD4 favourites, with a 75.6% win probability to Charlton's 10.6%.
Only once in the last eight campaigns have City enjoyed a longer winning start than this one, winning each of their first four matches in 2019-20.
But they will be supremely confident of matching that feat at The Valley, in what will be their first competitive meeting with Charlton in the WSL era.
Promoted sides have won just one of their last 28 meetings with the reigning champions in the competition (D3 L24), with Liverpool recording a 2-1 home win over Chelsea in September 2022.

Last time out, Khadija Shaw became the first player to score in each of City's first three games of a WSL campaign, and she could become the fifth player to do so in the first four matches of a season for any club.
London City Lionesses were 4-1 winners at Charlton last Saturday and currently sit fourth in the table with six points on the board ahead facing a winless Brighton.
Alexia Putellas and company are assigned a 52.9% win probability on Saturday, with Brighton only winning 23.0% of the supercomputer's pre-match simulations.

London City's three wins in their last four WSL matches (L1) are more than they managed across their previous 12 in the competition (W2 D3 L7), and their nine ‘big’ chances against Charlton last week were the most by any team in a WSL game since October 2020 (when Man Utd had 10 versus Brighton).

The Seagulls could fail to win their opening four matches of a WSL campaign for the third time after 2018-19 (first six) and 2019-20 (first five), and they have lost seven of their last nine league games in London.

Olid got her first win on the board with Manchester United in the Women’s League Cup on Wednesday, with a 10-1 thrashing of Sheffield United, and they will now look to translate that into a WSL victory.
The Red Devils are given a 68.0% chance of beating West Ham – whose own chances sit at 14.3% – having gone unbeaten in their last 12 league games against the Hammers (W8 D4).

Man Utd are winless in their first three WSL matches (D1 L2) for the first time and lost two of their last three home games in the competitions (D1), as many defeats as across their previous 20 (W12 D6).
West Ham struggle on their travels against the Red Devils, having lost each of their six WSL away games by an aggregate score of 1-19.
They have only won one of their three games this term (L2), but given United have attempted just 10 shots in the WSL in 2026-27, they will feel this is a good chance to get one over on them.
